content.short: Highlight provides high-quality tools to help creative professionals thrive in Web3.
content.description: Highlight provides a focused toolkit to craft curated Web3 experiences. It enables NFT drops using gas-efficient, creator-owned contracts, giving creators more control over token rights and costs. You can easily embed mints and auctions from Highlight directly onto your own site, simplifying the integration process without sacrificing performance. In addition, you can gate experiences to tailor access and create unique, collector-focused journeys that reward engagement and loyalty.
content.meta: Highlight provides tools to create curated Web3 experiences. Discover Highlight and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
